name: Splay
description: A fan opening across the sheet: the pair of blades spreading column by column.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 42%; top: 6%; width: 16%; height: 88%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); transform-origin: 50% 100%; -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc(-4 - 40 * @x / @X)deg); transform: rotate(@calc(-4 - 40 * @x / @X)deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 42%; top: 6%; width: 16%; height: 88%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); transform-origin: 50% 100%; -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc(4 + 40 * @x / @X)deg); transform: rotate(@calc(4 + 40 * @x / @X)deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
